_README: Parity test vectors: input keypoint sets -> expected decoded output. Both platforms run these through their full feature-extraction + classification + decode path and MUST produce identical results (spec §6 parity guarantee). THIS FILE IS A SKELETON: real vectors cannot be authored until semaphore_alphabet.json is VERIFIED (Epic 1), because the expected outputs depend on the frozen (left,right)->character mapping and the id<->angle convention. See shared/README.md.

_format.keypoints: Object with the six shared keypoints, each [x, y, confidence], already normalized to [0,1], y-up, signer's perspective (i.e. post-adapter). Keys: left_shoulder,left_elbow,left_wrist,right_shoulder,right_elbow,right_wrist.
_format.mode_before: Decoder mode entering this vector: 'LETTERS' or 'NUMERIC' (for stateful numeric-mode tests, §4.5).
_format.expected: Expected emitted character (or '' for a mode-switch / indeterminate frame that emits nothing).
_format.expected_position_ids: Optional [left_id, right_id] for white-box checking of the quantization step before alphabet lookup.
